import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    numbers = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    total = sum(numbers)
    print(int(total / n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
